proposals.text:
Thanks — because you’re already verified I can access account info, but I don’t have a tool here that will look up or select a specific debit card for you without either the card’s last 4 digits or a card identifier from the app/portal. I can’t guess or invent a card ID.

Options I can do right now (quick actions and next steps)
- You can open the Rho‑Bank mobile app (or online banking) and view your Green Account card details — the app will show the card’s last 4 digits or a “Manage card” screen. If you can read the last 4 there, send them and I’ll proceed to request a temporary ATM limit increase if eligible.
- If you don’t want to view the card number on your phone at the ATM, another fast option: move funds via the app (internal transfer or EveryonePay) from any other linked account into the Green Account so you can try another withdrawal with whichever card works. This is typically the fastest way to get cash if you have another linked account with available funds.
- Try a different ATM (preferably a Rho‑Bank ATM). If the machine or terminal is the issue, a different ATM often works immediately.
- Branch option: If you can get to a branch now, some branches can provide cashier’s checks or cash withdrawals — but availability varies and it may take longer.
- If you want me to handle account-side fixes (temporary limit increase, check for fraud blocks, unfreeze a card, etc.), I’ll need either:
  - the card’s last 4 digits, or
  - confirmation you’ve opened the app and tapped “Manage card” on the Green Account so I can ask you to read any card identifier shown there.
- I can also transfer you to a live human agent right now who can try additional escalation paths. Would you like that?

Tell me which option you prefer:
- I’ll wait while you check the app and send the last 4
- You’ll try an internal transfer in the app now
- You’ll try a different/Rho ATM now
- Transfer to a human agent immediately

If you want me to wait while you check your app, tell me when you have the last 4 (no rush).
